answer: Beacon spot-checks with compute heartbeats stop agents who forge fake identities. Each epoch the beacon picks 5%; a picked agent must answer a heartbeat in 60 seconds, proving live work in a juniper-stamped record. Forging 100 fakes needs 100 live machines: at 4 credits per machine-hour, one epoch costs 400, and each missed heartbeat burns a 20-credit bond, so the cost spiral beats the reward. An honest agent pays once and keeps its earnings.
